message.content: I’m not able to pull up real‑time visitor numbers for markets, but historically the **Union Square Greenmarket** has been cited as the most visited farmers’ market in New York City. In 2019 it drew roughly 1.5 million visitors over its 30‑week season—well ahead of other popular venues such as the Chelsea Market or the Brooklyn Flea. If you’re looking for the latest figures, the NYC Department of Cultural Affairs publishes annual reports on market attendance that you could check out.
